acceptanceCriteria: Retain owner decisions and a bounded experimental contract distinguishing historical integrity, observed behavior, reviewer-attested semantic mapping and current Tasks applicability; no accepted-profile promotion is implied by this ticket.

Demonstrate one real disposable Tasks lifecycle using one language and repair/preservation/new-behavior relations, with immutable criterion, oracle, base/candidate execution tree, attempt generation, runner and integration bindings; offline consumer rederives permitted facts without executing commands.

Retain valid repair, base-incompatible test, circular oracle, surviving control, invalid compilation control, omitted criterion, changed acceptance/config, contradictory/flaky attempts and stale integration cases without false closure; semantic ambiguities remain unresolved.

Preregister an external held-out matched three-arm evaluation: current CEM, equally strong ordinary testing, and the same testing plus criterion packets/Tasks consumption. Match model, review time, tools, experiment compute and full-task budget; freeze sample selection, numerical thresholds, adjudication and uncertainty reporting before execution.

Measure wrong acceptance, false rejection, preservation misses, next-action accuracy, review/full-lifecycle cost and stale evidence rejection after a follow-up edit. A feasibility pilot is not superiority evidence. Stop or simplify the new-profile hypothesis if persistent packets do not improve decisions or lifecycle cost over equally strong ordinary testing.
body:
Owner exploration request 2026-09-30: "I'd like you to explore them. I'm still looking for that next gen breakthrough on this"; clarified "I meant 0.4, if we already have a 0.3" and "also I'd love if it could be tied in with tasks, and tests and things like that." Usage credits explicitly authorized. This retains a research hypothesis, not accepted implementation intent, protocol promotion or execution cutover. Standing owner instruction authorizes automatic filing of concrete ideas.

Current evidence: docs/CHANGE-EVIDENCE-MAP.md:140-197 already has typed evidence roles, structural supported semantics, coverage and bounded mutation witnesses. docs/specs/ocm-v0-dogfood.md:42-65 enumerates scoped requirements. Browser behavior falsification already supplies criterion/assertion-bound controls and outcome classification. The accepted hypothesis catalog docs/specs/applied-intelligence-breakthroughs-v0.md:54-68 already describes missing-test generation with fail-before/pass-after or registered mutation qualification. Tasks external review binds canonical acceptance, candidate, gates and reviewer-attested claims, while its CEM/OCM fields remain unsupported/null (docs/specs/corvint-tasks-external-agent-review-v0.md:36-40,71-79). Do not advertise any of these methods as new inventions or universally adequate proof.

Hypothesis: portable criterion-experiment records can preserve useful experimental evidence across task planning, candidate review, integration and later edits. The record joins exact canonical acceptance revision/claim identity, CEM patch/hunk group, reviewed expected observation, same oracle package and constructed execution trees, configuration/toolchain/runner identities, all original attempts, valid registered wrong alternatives, contradictory observations and unresolved cases. Ask which registered wrong alternatives remain compatible with the current evidence and use that bounded set to select the next useful test. Absence of a surviving registered alternative never means absence of all bugs.

Prototype first as a separate experimental adapter packet beside canonical CEM 0.2; do not invent a promoted cem/0.4 wire or change frozen vectors. Keep CEM reference-only/local/source-content-free, deterministic consumer offline, execution in a separately invoked contained runner. No default LLM generation, daemon, hosted database, account or new queue. An opt-in Tasks policy may consume exact criterion coverage and experiment receipts bound to acceptance/generation/candidate; existing command gates, independent review and integration remain required. Semantic mapping and oracle authority remain reviewer-attested with independent owner-accepted criterion evidence, not inferred from implementation outputs. Preserve all old completion receipts as history; subsequent stale applicability produces maintenance proposals in the existing queue, not retroactive erasure or silent reopening.

Use separate behavioral relations for repair, preservation and new behavior; no universal fail-before rule. A base-incompatible imported test is unsupported comparison. Controls must compile, reach the expected assertion, preserve declared setup/unrelated criteria and clean up; crashes or unrelated failures do not count as kills. Equivalent controls are applicability unknowns. Freeze selection before execution and retain all requested/rejected/omitted/applicable/executed denominators and retries. Any candidate/oracle/dependency/config/acceptance/policy change initially invalidates current applicability; selective reuse awaits qualified exclusion witnesses. No global causality claim.

Independent bounded native Codex critique (Astra/medium, 2026-09-30) supports a prototype of lifecycle evidence but found no established product superiority. It specifically required stronger oracle authority, exact base/candidate execution-tree bindings, denominator controls and a matched stronger-testing baseline. No product tests or comparative trial were run during this exploration. Context query succeeded on mixed tree 91dfbeaa5e6c4b705b4e2f029d2164726449541e with two omitted results and 23 withheld test candidates; no completeness claim. Installed Core 1.0.0-rc.1 build163 and Tasks build202; official check observed v1.0.0-rc.1 and tasks-dev-20260929.2, with publisher identity NOT_VERIFIED and broad qualification absent.

Deduplication: native searches for counterfactual, contrastive and CEM 0.4 returned no rows; all 33 CEM+ideas results inspected by title, plus V1-0501/V1-0504 acceptance criteria. Related existing work V1-0499 (bounded mutation), V1-0501/V1-0195 (proof review), V1-0504 (synthetic tour), V1-0197 (receipt bundle) stays open/unchanged. This is a comparative research question spanning lifecycle evidence, not a replacement for those delivery tickets.
title: CEM 0.4 research: carry criterion-level acceptance experiments through Tasks and tests
